mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h: MONSTER_MODEL_ASSASSIN = 14, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster15.bmd. The client's name is 암살자, assassin; OpenMU's Version075 Devias.cs:140-158 names number 21 'Assassin' at level 26 with 800 health, 95-100 damage, 33 defense, MoveRange 2, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 7, AttackDelay 2000, respawn 10 s. Thirty-five of them in 128-251 by 0-128, the town's quarter, with the Worms (Devias.cs:69).
rig_from:
Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, exported with --actions=0,1,2,3,4,5,6. Keys: 20, 10, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7. 35 bones, five of them dummies, and jytrchant at the end.

Play speeds: the defaults, with the second idle at 0.35 (`b->Actions[MONSTER01_STOP2].PlaySpeed = 0.35f` in his sound case, ZzzOpenData.cpp:3517) and STOP2 looped (`case MONSTER_MODEL_ASSASSIN: b->Actions[MONSTER01_STOP2].Loop = true`, ZzzOpenData.cpp:3355-3360) -- which only decides that the clip wraps rather than holds, as every idle does here. BoneHead 20 is Bip01 Head.
sheet_from: Two meshes in Monster15.bmd: snowking.jpg, 604 triangles, the body; sword05.jpg, 132 triangles, the sword. snowking.OZJ is 128 by 128 with no alpha, decoded under an assassin_ prefix. sword05.OZJ decodes byte-identical to source/textures/sword05.png, which the Katache (Sword04) already wears, so that file is reused rather than copied: the Assassin's blade is painted from the same sheet as the Katache.
sheet_materials_from: snowking at 4x: black robes -- a hood and cowl in heavy folds, a long tabard with a silver-edged panel and a painted sigil, a skull-and-crossbones plate on the back -- over a belt of dark studs with one red gem at the buckle. Almost all of it is black cloth, and the silver is trim painted on the cloth, not plate: cloth. sword05 at 8x: a pale steel blade with a dark fuller, a tan guard and a red grip: blade_steel for the blade. The Katache found the same sheet splits by geometry into blade, guard, grip and banner; see islands_from for what this mesh's islands turned out to be.
effects_from:
None on the body. MODEL_ASSASSIN is in CreateMonster and in two exceptions and in nothing else -- no per-frame switch in MoveCharacterVisual or RenderCharacter, no missile. The two exceptions are both things he does NOT do:

- CreateBlood (ZzzEffectBlurSpark.cpp:456) skips him with the Ghost and the Ice Queen: no blood thrown from the head bone when he dies. The game draws no death blood for anyone yet, so there is nothing to turn off.
- ZzzCharacter.cpp:1411: a monster struck cries Sounds[2 + rand()%2], `o->Type != MODEL_ASSASSIN`. He takes a blow in silence -- the flinch cry is skipped by type, in the game's Play::flinch.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3511-3518: mAssassinAttack1, mAssassinAttack2 and mAssassinDie, then SetMonsterSound(..., -1, -1, 65, 66, 67). The -1s leave him no idle or move cry at all, and he is struck silently (effects_from). He is heard only when he swings and when he dies. Wired as assassin_* in sounds.json; there is deliberately no assassin_move.
islands_from: Fifteen islands. 0-8 are the body, 604 triangles, all cloth. 9-14 are TWO swords of 66 triangles each (132, sword05's count): he carries a blade in each hand, one along -146..-25 and one along -28..76. Each sword is the Katache's geometry to the texel -- its islands' mu_uv match Sword04's exactly -- without the Katache's two banner islands, so each takes Sword04's materials: the red grip (9, 12) leather_wrap, the blade (10, 13) blade_steel, the tan guard (11, 14) brass. They arrived as skin, the monster profile's default, and were set here.
